READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Animated movies are loved by people of all ages. Long ago, artists drew every single picture by hand on transparent sheets called cels. It took thousands of drawings to make just one minute of film! Today, animators use powerful computers and 3D software to create lifelike textures, lighting, and expressions. Famous animation studios like Pixar and Studio Ghibli spend up to four years making a single movie. The key to a great animated film is not just fancy technology, but a heartwarming story with relatable characters.

questions.q: How did artists make animated movies long ago?
questions.a: They drew every picture by hand
options: They drew every picture by hand

questions.q: How long does it take to make a feature movie?
What is the key to a great animated film?
questions.a: A heartwarming story and relatable characters
options: A heartwarming story and relatable characters
Making it as short as possible

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: One of the most famous stories in English literature is the legend of King Arthur. According to the tale, Britain had no king and the land was in chaos. In a churchyard in London, a magical sword appeared stuck inside a solid stone anvil with golden letters: 'Whoso pulleth out this sword is rightwise King of England'. Many strong knights and nobles pulled with all their strength, but nobody could move it. One day, a young boy named Arthur tried. He pulled the sword out easily and became a wise, just king.

questions.q: Where was the magical sword stuck?
options: At the bottom of the sea

questions.q: Could the strong knights pull the sword out?
Who pulled the sword out easily?
What kind of king did Arthur become?

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Last Friday, students at Oakwood Secondary School completed their Final Project. During the week, they inspected the streets near their school and recorded the types of litter they found. Most litter consisted of plastic drink bottles, snack packets, and soda cans. On Saturday morning, thirty volunteers gathered at Riverside Park. Equipped with sturdy gloves, bin bags, and safety boots, they collected over fifty bags of rubbish in just three hours. Afterwards, the team created colourful posters to encourage everyone in the neighbourhood to keep the park clean.
